reason: The user asked for ELI5 bullet status updates and for a direct answer to "anything needed from my side? is it faster?". The coordinator's reports slipped into ticket IDs and build jargon ("CP-8", "migration", "rules.json"). A status-report rule keeps founder updates plain.

The founder asked twice in the same episode why work was stalled and which rules applied, and said the answer was not clear. The replies were dense with issue numbers (#516, #525), spec IDs (UI-1, UI-13, UI-14), agent names ("proof-writer") and label names, which the status rule already forbids but the reply still used.
The same plain-English rule applies to design and scope documents the founder reads, not only to status reports. The trigger should name them so the rule is found when a design is written.
